title: SAP Fiori/UI5 Developer
summary: SAP Fiori/UI5 developers build the web and mobile screens people use to work in SAP systems, using SAPUI5 (SAP's JavaScript UI library) and Fiori elements templates. They work in SAP project teams with ABAP developers and functional consultants, connecting screens to backend OData services (SAP's standard web data interface).
dailyDuties: Build freestyle SAPUI5 apps from functional specs
Generate Fiori elements apps from CDS annotations
Connect apps to OData services and debug data issues
Deploy apps from Business Application Studio to SAP BTP
Configure Fiori launchpad tiles, catalogs and roles
Fix UI defects raised in testing and support

skills.expectation: Build freestyle SAPUI5 and Fiori elements apps that follow Fiori design guidelines
Write JavaScript controllers, formatters and custom controls
Use HTML5 and CSS3 for layouts and theming
Consume and troubleshoot OData V2/V4 services and use CDS annotations from the S/4HANA backend
Develop in SAP Business Application Studio and deploy apps to SAP BTP
Configure Fiori launchpad catalogs, groups, tiles and target mappings
Work with functional consultants and business users on screens and fixes
Use Git for app source and code reviews
Build simple backend services with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model
Write QUnit and OPA5 tests for apps
Read and make small ABAP changes on the backend
Use pipelines to build and transport apps

certifications.why: Useful when the role also covers the ABAP Cloud and RAP backend behind Fiori apps
